values.note: One family restroom with showers, kept locked: call 719-537-6622 (day) or 719-940-1991 (evening) to have it opened. Restrooms winterized and closed October through April.

values.note: Pay on site; reservations optional, through the town clerk's office (719-537-6622).

note: Town of Holly municipal RV park on W. Highway 50, an overnight stop in far eastern CO. $20/night per the sweep (no rate on the town's pages as of 2026-10-28). Shade trees, picnic tables, enclosed play yard; tent spaces too. --Claude
